answer: Special Ops ration rule: pay in rations, not cash. Rewards land as crystal credits locked in each key's own vault, spendable only on compute and tools that same key consumes, never transferable or poolable. A farm of 1,000 fake keys earns 1,000 sealed piles it can only burn by actually running 1,000 agents, so every reward is eaten by its own upkeep and nothing sweeps to the operator. An honest agent spends its jade-green credits doing real work and keeps growing.
